name: SinSiege
detailed_description:
SinSiege is a wild fusion of strategy, action, and survivor-style chaos — where every wave pushes you to evolve your strategy and every hero adds a new twist to the holy war. Whether you're here for the depth or the devilry, one thing's for sure:

Hell isn’t ready for Adamkind.

Strategy. Survival. Sanctified mayhem.

Hell has declared war on humanity's last outposts — embassies built deep in the inferno to keep a fragile peace. But now, the Seven Sins rise, and the flames of diplomacy are burning out fast.

The world’s final hope? A decision from on high: send the Earth's mightiest heroes.

All of them.

Welcome to the Consulate of Adamkind, humanity's last foothold in Hell — and your battlefield.

Game Features

  • Survivor-Like Meets Tower Defense, Then Meets Rogue-Like
    Build, upgrade, and merge divine towers to hold back relentless waves of corrupted foes.

  • Legendary Heroes, Each with Unique Loadouts
    Choose from a growing roster of over-the-top champions, each wielding their own sacred (or not-so-sacred) arsenal.

  • Face the Seven Sins
    Each sin brings twisted bosses, custom enemy waves, and brutal new challenges.

  • Epic Boss Fights
    Prepare for screen-shaking battles where timing, placement, and raw power are everything.

  • Cheesy But Righteous Story
    A tongue-in-cheek tale of celestial bureaucracy, moral compromise, and very confused soldiers of God.

  • An Unholy Soundtrack
    Rock, choir, and chaos — each track fuels the fire of battle.

short_description: SinSiege is a action rogue-like/tower defense hybrid set in Hell, where humanity's embassies is under siege. Play as legendary heroes, build divine defenses, and face off against waves of demons corrupted by the Seven Sins in a battle to protect mankind’s final haven in hell.

English*, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 / AMD HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Integrated GPUs may work poorly

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains depictions of fantasy violence, including combat against demonic creatures. Enemies may be defeated using weapons or magical abilities, and they disappear or dissolve upon defeat. While the theme involves battling evil forces, there is no realistic blood, gore, or graphic content. The game uses stylized pixel art and maintains a dark fantasy tone.
